Camping Resort Amenities

Settle in, step outside, and enjoy the beauty of the Hudson Valley. Our shared amenities are here for guests staying in houses, rooms, and cabins.

PART OF YOUR STAY

Included amenities.

Find your favorite way to spend an unhurried day.

Included

Campground WiFi

Complimentary basic wireless internet helps you stay connected throughout camp. Upgraded WiFi is available for an additional fee.

Included

Communal Fire Pits

Gather under the stars, roast marshmallows, and share stories after a day outdoors.

Included

Soccer Field

Enjoy a friendly game or join activities in our open grassy field.

Included

Hiking Trails

Discover our on-site trail network, with trailheads close to your accommodations.

Included

Gaga Ball Pit

Bring your group together for a little friendly competition with this camp favorite.

Included

Game Room

Head indoors for foosball, ping pong, or a game of pool.

Included

Boating

Enjoy Mirror Lake with kayaks, canoes, pedal boats, and row boats provided for guests.

MAKE IT YOURS

A few optional extras.

Add something special to your stay. Additional charges apply.

Add-on

Firewood

Firewood is available to purchase on-site for your next campfire.

Add-on

Golf Cart Rentals

Ask about renting a golf cart to get around the property during your stay.

Add-on

Rock Climbing Tower & Vertical Playpen

Join our recreation team for an adventure on the 35-foot climbing tower.

Add-on

Archery Range

Find your aim with a session at our archery range.

Add-on

Low Ropes Course

Build communication and share a laugh with your group, guided by a recreation facilitator.

Contact our team to confirm availability, pricing, activity schedules, and participation requirements.
